note: Score each expected_behavior line independently. These are authored evaluations, not executed results.

scenarios.title: Product UI pack
scenarios.query: Choose and apply a visual system to a dense internal dashboard with no existing identity.
expected_behavior: Defaults to workbench unless the brief gives a stronger register
States calibration values and why the product-UI row wins
Uses the pack token file rather than hand-copying values
Keeps cinematic motion out of high-repetition product UI

scenarios.title: Cinematic landing
scenarios.query: Design a scroll-driven infrastructure landing page with particles, reduced motion and a static fallback.
expected_behavior: Loads the cinematic and motion doctrine references
Uses one measured scroll clock for all layers
Defines a calm fully legible fallback in the same change
Verifies mid-hold, mid-morph and narrow-viewport states

scenarios.title: Figma crossing
scenarios.query: Publish the chosen pack into Figma variables and map it back into code.
expected_behavior: Loads the Figma bridge before operating on the file
Treats drawing in a shared frame as publishing
Maps variables and code tokens without hand-copied values
Names the destination instead of guessing where to create a file
